articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved chain-of-thought reasoning, native image and audio generation within a single unified model, and a larger effective context window. The model demonstrates substantial gains on graduate-level science benchmarks and complex multi-step coding tasks, narrowing the gap between AI assistants and domain experts in several STEM fields.

articles.title: Google DeepMind Unveils Gemini 2.5 Ultra with Million-Token Context and Agentic Capabilities
articles.summary: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra ships with a production-ready one-million-token context window and native tool-use capabilities that allow it to autonomously browse, code, and execute multi-step workflows. Early benchmarks show state-of-the-art performance on long-document comprehension and agentic task completion, intensifying competition in the frontier model space.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Humanoid Workers at BMW Facility
articles.summary: Figure AI has started deploying its Figure 02 humanoid robots on BMW assembly lines in Spartanburg, South Carolina, marking one of the first scaled commercial deployments of general-purpose humanoid robots in automotive manufacturing. The robots handle bin-picking, parts transfer, and quality inspection tasks, operating alongside human workers with updated safety-rated control systems.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Autonomous Warehouse Navigation and Dexterous Manipulation
articles.summary: Tesla showcased its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot performing end-to-end warehouse logistics tasks including shelf stocking, package sorting, and navigating dynamic environments without teleoperation. The system uses a vision-only transformer pipeline derived from Tesla's FSD stack, with significantly improved hand dexterity featuring 22 degrees of freedom per hand.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Agents with Formal Safety Guarantees
articles.summary: Anthropic released a new agentic framework for Claude that includes mathematically grounded constraint systems designed to prevent unintended actions during autonomous tool use. The framework uses a novel constitutional-AI-derived verification layer that checks planned actions against user-specified safety invariants before execution, addressing a key concern in deploying AI agents in production environments.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 2nm A16 Process with Backside Power Delivery
articles.summary: TSMC has commenced high-volume manufacturing on its A16 (1.6nm-class) process node featuring backside power delivery network (BSPDN) technology, delivering an estimated 10-15% speed improvement and 20-25% power reduction over N2. This process is expected to power next-generation AI accelerator chips from major fabless customers starting in late 2026, sustaining the pace of compute scaling critical for frontier AI training.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Reliable Logical Qubit Operations Below Error Correction Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum reported achieving below-threshold error rates on logical qubits using a new topological error correction code running on Quantinuum's latest trapped-ion system. The result marks a significant milestone toward fault-tolerant quantum computing, with logical error rates approximately 100x lower than physical qubit error rates, potentially accelerating the timeline for commercially useful quantum algorithms.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Electric Gains Autonomous Construction Site Capabilities
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics demonstrated its electric Atlas robot performing autonomous inspection and light manipulation tasks on active construction sites, including climbing scaffolding, carrying tools, and documenting progress via onboard LIDAR and camera systems. The company announced partnerships with three major construction firms for pilot programs beginning in Q3 2026, expanding humanoid robotics beyond the warehouse and factory floor.
